meta.name: dev-skillify
meta.description: Create a new custom skill for the workspace. Guides the user through defining the skill's slug, trigger conditions, workflow steps, outputs, and anti-patterns. Use when the user says 'create a skill', 'new skill', 'add a skill', 'I need a custom skill', or wants to formalize a workflow as a reusable skill.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 引导你创建可复用的工作区自定义技能
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想把重复工作流封装成可复用的技能
copy.tagline_en: Guide users to create reusable custom skills for the workspace
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to formalize a workflow as a reusable skill

howto.what: 这个技能会引导你一步步创建一个自定义技能（SKILL.md文件），定义可复用的工作流，Claude在匹配到触发条件时按步骤执行。
howto.when: 当你说出“create a skill”、“new skill”、“add a skill”等关键词，或想要将一个重复流程变成可复用的技能时触发。

say.text: 创建一个名为review-pr的技能，用于审查PR的安全性。
帮我把每日站会笔记的工作流做成一个技能。
我想把临时使用的代码检查流程变成一个可复用的技能。
say.note: Claude会引导定义触发条件等。

howto.what_en: This skill guides you step by step to create a custom skill (a SKILL.md file) that defines a reusable workflow, which Claude will execute when its trigger conditions are matched.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say 'create a skill', 'new skill', 'add a skill', or want to formalize a repeatable workflow into a reusable skill.

say_en.text: Create a skill called review-pr for reviewing PR security.
Turn my daily standup notes workflow into a skill.
say_en.note: Claude asks for details and generates SKILL.md.

say_en.text: I want to make my ad-hoc code review process a reusable skill.
say_en.note: Claude guides through defining triggers etc.
